editionData.description: Global headlines: U.S. and NATO commander vows to thwart Moscow, warns Kyiv over refinery strikes (The mixed signals expose a split in President Donald Trump’s approach to Russia, amid strain on energy markets); U.K. prime minister accuses Russia of meddling in Brexit vote (Officials scrambled to clarify that Andy Burnham’s remarks did not mean the government rejected the outcome of the controversial 2016 referendum); and This hurricane season in the Pacific just set a record for activity (A powerful El Niño has cemented 2026’s place as the busiest year on record for storm activity in the eastern and central tropical Pacific Ocean). Markets leaned lower, with 4 of 7 tracked indexes down; Nikkei 225 down 1.82% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: GLM-Legal (z.ai: GLM-Legal); Where is all the new, good software? (Here's a question we see, especially from AI skeptics: if AI coding is so great, shouldn't we be seeing more new, good software by now?...); and Intel D270 GPU AI Accelerator–Up to 480 GB LPDDR5X (intel.com: Intel D270 GPU AI Accelerator–Up to 480 GB LPDDR5X). Product Hunt features Scape (Orchestrate agent fleets with custom tools built on macOS), Upsolve Row-Level Security (Data permissions your AI agent can't talk its way past), and vibesmonitor.com (The ops center for everything you ship).

headlines.summary: At the Confucius Institute of Tashkent State University of Oriental Studies, Uzbekistan, students gathered on Sept 24 to make mooncakes, a traditional Chinese delicacy, deepening their understanding of the Mid-Autumn Festival through hands-on cultural exchange.

headlines.title: Houthis hit Riyadh's main airport again
headlines.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport was again attacked on Sunday, killing a Pakistani national just a day after a deadly strike by Yemen's Houthi militant group killed a dozen people there. The latest attack prompted the nation's General Authority of Civil Aviation, or GACA, to extend the airport's closure.

headlines.title: European leaders question Trump's Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire

headlines.title: Chinese and American youth join voices
headlines.summary: From a Disney classic to a traditional Chinese folk song, and from a classical Western piano masterpiece to a composition inspired by birdsong, young musicians from China and the United States explored different musical traditions before joining their voices in a concert finale on Thursday evening.

headlines.title: IMF edges up 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%
headlines.summary: BANGKOK - The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Tuesday nudged its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1 percent, up 0.1 percentage point from its July projection, as economies lifted by the artificial intelligence (AI) investment boom offset those hurt by the Middle East conflict.
